title: Quick Argentinian Roast Roast
description: A quick-fix Argentinian dish featuring roast beef, peppers, and cheese, finished with a squeeze of lemon juice.
instructions: Season the flank steak with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the steak to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, chop the bell peppers and onion, and sprinkle with oregano and parsley.
Add the chopped peppers and onion to the baking sheet with the steak for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Remove the steak from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the roasted peppers and cheese, if using.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and serve hot.
